I painted Warszawska Syrenka for the Bitcoin Film Festival in Warsaw. She is the city’s guardian, with hussar wings and a Bitcoin shield. I wanted the painting to carry Warsaw’s resilience, too: after World War II, its Old Town was rebuilt from ruins.

My new website is launching, with original paintings, fine-art prints, and commissions available to explore. Visit vermillionaurora.com.

In Honeybadger and Cub with Genesis Block, a fierce protector turns toward the future with tenderness. Behind them is Bitcoin’s Genesis block—the beginning of the chain. I built that pattern into the painting with clear-wax resist before adding watercolor.

For me, the painting brings together protection, care for future generations, and the freedom to build for the long term.

El Zonte at Dusk takes me back to my first Bitcoin conference in El Salvador, soon after Bukele’s election and the government’s arrests of gang members. I stayed at a hostel in El Zonte, Bitcoin Beach, right where the river runs through town to the ocean.

Every morning, incredible surfers headed out to the break. Our hostel host was wonderful, and I had an amazing time in town. This painting holds some of that feeling: the coast at day’s end, and the warmth of a place that welcomed me.
